name: @pipeworx/mcp-arxiv

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search arXiv preprints. Plain text searches all fields; use prefixes for targeted queries: au:hinton (author), ti:transformer (title), abs:diffusion (abstract), cat:cs.AI (category), all:quantum (any field). Combine with AND/OR/ANDNOT, e.g., "ti:transformer AND cat:cs.LG". Returns id, title, authors, abstract, categories, published date, PDF URL.

query.description: Query string. Plain text or field-prefixed (au:, ti:, abs:, cat:, all:). Combine terms with AND, OR, ANDNOT.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Fetch a single arXiv paper by its ID (e.g., "2310.06825", "2310.06825v2", or legacy "cs.CL/0301001"). Returns full metadata: title, authors, abstract, categories, DOI (if linked), PDF URL.

arxiv_id.description: arXiv identifier (with or without version suffix)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-arxiv forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the arxiv pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
